==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this skill if either they or their pet need healing, or if their pet is dead. While in combat, Heroes will attempt to maintain this skill on their pet, casting it once it has expired.

== Notes ==
* The [[life stealing]] effect is applied first, and therefore has an effect only if your pet is alive at casting.
* This skill can be activated without having a pet. It then acts as a simple [[self heal]].
* This skill has no [[aftercast delay]].

== Trivia ==
* The woman in the [[skill icon]] appears to be the same one in the [[Predatory Bond]] icon.
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see the [[Heal as One/Skill history|PvE]] and [[Heal as One (PvP)/Skill history|PvP]] skill histories for details.
